name: razorflow
description: RazorFlow — general browser agent SDK and demo

scripts.build:sdk: npm run build -w @strykerinside/razorflow-protocol && npm run build -w @strykerinside/razorflow-browser && npm run build -w @strykerinside/razorflow-client
scripts.typecheck:sdk: npm run typecheck -w @strykerinside/razorflow-protocol && npm run typecheck -w @strykerinside/razorflow-browser && npm run typecheck -w @strykerinside/razorflow-client
scripts.publish:sdk: npm run build:sdk && npm publish -w @strykerinside/razorflow-protocol --access public && npm publish -w @strykerinside/razorflow-browser --access public && npm publish -w @strykerinside/razorflow-client --access public
